turns.q: How many days do I have to return something?
turns.replyTail:
You have:

100 nights from delivery for mattresses, bed bases, beds and other eligible trial products.
30 days from receipt for bed linen and mattress protectors. These are not covered by the 100-night trial.
14 calendar days from receipt to exercise your legal right of withdrawal for any product.

To start your return:

Create your return request at https://www.tediber.com/a/return, using your six-digit order number.
Add photos if the products have been unpacked, so the return can be approved.
If your order included free products, return them too for the refund to be approved.

The return page will give you a link to schedule a carrier collection. Use this link only once, even if you do not receive an appointment confirmation.

The refund is made to the original payment method within 15 business days after the products reach our warehouse.

turns.q: Do I have to pay for return shipping?
turns.replyTail:
It depends on the country the product is returned from.

Returns are free in France, Corsica, Spain, Belgium, Luxembourg, Italy, Monaco, San Marino, Switzerland, the Czech Republic and Vatican City.

In Germany, Austria and the Netherlands, a change-of-mind return costs:

€39 for items totaling less than €200
€79 for €200 to less than €500
€129 for €500 to less than €1,500
€159 for €1,500 or more

These fees do not apply when the product is defective. Which country would the return be sent from?

turns.q: How long until I get my refund once you receive it?
turns.replyTail: Once your returned products reach our warehouse, the refund is processed within 15 business days and sent to the original payment method. Your bank may then take additional time to display the funds.

turns.q: Can I exchange for a different size or option instead of a refund?
turns.replyTail: No, we don’t offer direct exchanges for a different size or option. Please return the original product for a refund, then place a new order for the size or option you want.

turns.q: Are any items final sale / non-returnable?
Do I need the original packaging to return something?
turns.replyTail:
No, you do not need the original packaging for bulky items such as mattresses, bed bases, beds or headboards. Mattresses do not need to be rolled back into their original carton, and the carrier normally provides a protective cover during collection.

For small parcels, attach the return label to the parcel. In all cases, the product must be complete and in good condition.

turns.q: Can I return an online order in a physical store?
turns.replyTail: No. Returns cannot be processed in a physical Tediber store. Start your online-order return through the online return form using your six-digit order number.
